== Summary ==
[[Chris Menzel]] (back to camera) hands out a prize bag; [[Tamás Papp]] applauds. [[Casey Anis]] is seated in the pale yellow T-shirt (bald, light beard; same shirt and face as #12 in [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]).

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day. The man in black is very likely Chris Menzel (same shirt and hair) but his face is not visible, so he is not tagged.
